t: Kensington Palace sits within Kensington Gardens, and it has been a residence for the British royal family since the seventeenth century. Today it is the official London home of several royals, including the Prince and Princess of Wales. Queen Victoria was born here and lived here, long before her reign of more than sixty-three years. Queen Anne died here. Diana, Princess of Wales lived here from 1981 to 1997. Her sons, William and Harry, lived here as well. Catherine, Princess of Wales lived here from 2012 to 2022.
